label: PrimeNG
notes: PrimeNG binds values with [(ngModel)]; awd controls use a signal `value` model — migrate `[(ngModel)]="x"` to `[(value)]="x"` (or reactive forms via awd-input-field). PrimeNG form controls are usually standalone; awd form controls are typically wrapped in `awd-input-field` for label/hint/error chrome. Icons are set via `icon*` inputs (e.g. `iconDropdown`) or projected `awd-icon`, not template slots. Always verify target inputs with get_control before rewriting.

components.notes: Attribute directive on a native <button>/<a>. Label and icon are projected content, not inputs.

props.notes: Project the label as the button's text content.
Project an awd-icon element; use kind="icon" for an icon-only button.
Map severity onto kind + color; see the theming kinds-colors guide and get_theme_options.

gaps: ngnButton has no `loading` or `disabled` input — use the native [disabled] attribute and render your own loading state.

components.notes: Options are passed via `options`; item label/value come from the item shape or `templateItem`. Placeholder/label live on the wrapping awd-input-field.
gaps: No `optionLabel` / `optionValue` / `showClear` inputs — set the item label via `templateItem`, and clearing via awd-input-field's `showClearButton`.

components.notes: Use awd-select with `multiple`.

props.notes: awd-select uses `checkbox` for multi-select affordance; chip display differs — verify with get_control.

components.notes: Use editable awd-select (`editable`). Server-side suggestion loading differs — verify capabilities.
gaps: Async suggestion completion works differently; may need custom filtering.
No `minDate`/`maxDate` or `selectionMode` inputs — verify range/min-max support with get_control before relying on it.

components.notes: Group radios with awd-radio-group; bind [(value)] on the group.

Attribute directive on native <input>/<textarea>; wrap in awd-input-field for chrome. Move any `id` off the input onto the wrapper: `<awd-input-field [inputId]="'old-id'">` — the field overwrites an id left on the projected input, breaking external `<label for>` / `aria-describedby` references.

gaps: No dedicated password meter component; use a native password input with ngnInput.
No dual-thumb `range` input; use two sliders or a custom control for ranges.

props.notes: Header/footer are projected/inputs; verify with get_control.

components.notes: Trigger + content projection differs; verify with get_control.

props.notes: The text is the directive value.
Verify menu item shape with get_control.

components.notes: Tab panels are projected; verify structure with get_control.
Panels via awd-accordion-panel.
Column/template model differs substantially. Migrate incrementally and verify with get_control + the table docs.
gaps: Feature parity for advanced datatable features (row grouping, cell editing, virtual scroll) must be verified case by case.

components.notes: Verify node model with get_control.
Attribute directive that overlays a counter/dot on the host element; awd-badge-indicator is the standalone element form. Directive inputs are awd-prefixed aliases.
awd also ships awd-snackbar; pick per UX.
Apply ngnInput to a native <textarea>; wrap in awd-input-field.
awd-input-field provides icon slots + clear button; use its iconClearButton/showClearButton rather than a separate icon-field wrapper.
Compose addons as projected content inside awd-input-field.
awd ships both awd-inplace and awd-edit-inplace; pick per behavior.
Value is a signal model ([(value)]); half stars come from step=0.5 rather than a separate input.

props.notes: awd-rating is clearable by default (re-click the active value); set [clearable]="false" to disable.

components.notes: Renders inline or as a popover trigger; the value is a signal model in the chosen format.

props.notes: awd also has [popover] for a trigger + overlay variant with [(open)].

gaps: No appendTo — overlay placement is controlled with [anchor].

components.notes: Grouped control with no single focusable element — label it with [labelledBy], not <label for>.

props.notes: (completed) fires once every slot is filled.

components.notes: Each step is an <awd-step> child; the active index is a signal model on awd-stepper.
Virtualization is opt-in — set [virtual] together with [itemHeight]; the item template is projected with [ngnScrollerItem].

props.notes: For server-driven data use awd-table's dataSource, or load into `items` yourself.

gaps: No card/panel container control; compose layout with plain elements + Tailwind and awd controls for the contents.
No split-button control; compose a button[ngnButton] with an awd-menu for the dropdown actions.
